extraction_warnings: Schema fields (subject_id, sample_id, curator, pmid) are designed for per-sample metadata (e.g., curatedMetagenomicData style) but this paper only reports cohort-level aggregate statistics for the newly sequenced Ghana/Ethiopia/Tanzania cohorts; no individual-level rows exist in the provided text.

Sex field is an enum requiring a single value, but several subgroups (Ghana adults, Tanzania adults) report mixed-sex percentages (not 100%); these were marked not_reported to avoid fabricating a single-sex assignment, with percentages preserved in notes.

Age_group classification is an approximation based on cohort mean ages and the paper's own 'adult/child/infant' labels; actual reported ranges (e.g., Ghana children 0-15 yrs) span multiple schema-defined age-group bands.
No PMID is stated in the paper body text itself; the paper_id (31607556) provided as input was not used to populate the pmid field since it lacks an in-text verbatim quote.

Supplementary files mmc1.pdf and mmc7.pdf provided appear to be cover/reference pages only and do not contain an extractable per-sample data table; hence granularity was kept at subgroup_level rather than sample_level.

This paper is a microbial genomics/population-genetics study (Prevotella copri), not a clinical cohort study, so most clinical/demographic schema fields (zygosity, BMI, disease response, HLA, neonatal details, obgyn status, smoking, treatment, tumor staging) are not reported.

Demographic details (age, sex, headcount) are available only for the three newly sequenced non-Westernized cohorts (Ghana, Ethiopia, Tanzania), stratified by adult/child(infant) subgroup, in the Experimental Model and Subject Details section; other cohorts (CRC, T2D, IBD, ancient samples, public datasets) lack participant-level demographic or clinical detail in the provided text.
Sex ratio (e.g., 100% female for Ethiopia adults, ~52% female for Ghana) was reported but is not part of the given schema fields, so it was not extracted despite being available.

No sample-level (per-participant) table with individual rows for age/BMI/disease was found in the main text or supplementary files provided; only aggregate subgroup statistics (mean, SD, range) were available, so granularity was set to subgroup_level rather than sample_level.

Supplementary data files (Tables S1-S5) are referenced as containing per-sample metadata (e.g., age, BMI, disease status for public datasets) but their actual content/tables were not included in the provided text, so sample-level extraction could not be performed from them.

Host species field applies uniformly across the entire study (all human hosts); no non-human host organisms were sampled.
